## Problem and result

Concrete trigger/current behavior, intended player journey and why it matters.
Name the actual runtime modules/assets, not only the inspection page.

## Scope

Included work, explicit exclusions, smallest complete slice and risky unknowns.
Record changed coordinate/seed/protocol/save/asset/input contracts and any required decision.

## Acceptance

Observable results, failure behavior, keyboard/controller/touch route, data ownership
and applicable visual/performance budgets. Write these before building.

## Verification

Meaningful existing/new checks, reproduction, baseline/candidate evidence, exact
environment/seed/settings and who performs independent review. Include migrations,
rollback or asset provenance when relevant. Never pre-fill results as passed.

## Delivery

Tested commit/export, known limits, integrated/deployed status, next concrete action
and links to review/handoff. A prototype/studio result must remain explicitly labeled.
